svg.title: The Wayfarer keeps watch while exploited bugs and malware rise to the top and one upgrade clears three findings
svg.desc: Five finding cards on a navy board reorder: the terracotta card with a flame, an actively exploited bug, and the dark card with a bug, malicious code, climb past the others to the top. A best-upgrade table appears; its top row, one upgrade that clears three findings, is picked and those three cards are ticked off.
